DualMCU_RP2040.name=UNIT DualMCU RP2040

DualMCU_RP2040.vid.0=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.0=0x000a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.1=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.1=0x010a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.2=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.2=0x400a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.3=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.3=0x410a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.4=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.4=0x800a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.5=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.5=0x810a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.6=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.6=0xc00a
DualMCU_RP2040.vid.7=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.pid.7=0xc10a

DualMCU_RP2040.build.usbvid=-DUSBD_VID=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.build.usbpid=-DUSBD_PID=0x000a
DualMCU_RP2040.build.usbpwr=-DUSBD_MAX_POWER_MA=250

DualMCU_RP2040.build.board=UNIT_DUALMCU_RP2040
DualMCU_RP2040.build.mcu=cortex-m0plus
DualMCU_RP2040.build.chip=rp2040
DualMCU_RP2040.build.toolchain=arm-none-eabi
DualMCU_RP2040.build.toolchainpkg=pqt-gcc
DualMCU_RP2040.build.toolchainopts=-march=armv6-m -mcpu=cortex-m0plus -mthumb
DualMCU_RP2040.build.uf2family=--family rp2040
DualMCU_RP2040.build.variant=DualMCU_RP2040

DualMCU_RP2040.upload.tool=uf2conv
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.tool.default=uf2conv
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.tool.network=uf2conv-network
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.maximum_size=2097152
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.maximum_data_size=262144
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.wait_for_upload_port=true
DualMCU_RP2040.upload.erase_cmd=

DualMCU_RP2040.serial.disableDTR=false
DualMCU_RP2040.serial.disableRTS=false

DualMCU_RP2040.build.f_cpu=125000000
DualMCU_RP2040.build.led=
DualMCU_RP2040.build.core=rp2040
DualMCU_RP2040.build.ldscript=memmap_default.ld
DualMCU_RP2040.build.ram_length=256k
DualMCU_RP2040.build.debugscript=picoprobe.tcl
DualMCU_RP2040.build.boot2=boot2_w25q080_2_padded_checksum

DualMCU_RP2040.build.vid=0x2e8a
DualMCU_RP2040.build.pid=0x000a
DualMCU_RP2040.build.usb_manufacturer="UNIT Electronics"
DualMCU_RP2040.build.usb_product="DualMCU RP2040"
